0.long_answer: Bromocriptine is recommended for pregnant patients with prolactinoma because it has a long-standing record of safety in pregnancy. While both bromocriptine and cabergoline are effective dopamine agonists for managing hyperprolactinemia and shrinking prolactin-secreting tumors, bromocriptine is favored during pregnancy primarily due to the more extensive safety data available for it. This makes bromocriptine the preferred choice in situations where there is limited safety data regarding the use of other prolactin-lowering medications during pregnancy.
